svg.title: How Buff Your Money is built
svg.desc: People: User and family, AI agent. App: Web app, MCP server. Services: Worker, AgentBuff login. Data: PostgreSQL. Docker Compose on a VPS with three database roles, a worker, backup before every deploy and a restore drill.
svg.text: The main parts and how data moves between them.
